verses.text: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
lines: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger,
neither discipline me in your wrath.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
lines: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint.
Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

verses.text: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?
lines: My soul is also in great anguish.
But you, Yahweh—how long?

verses.text: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
lines: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul,
and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

verses.text: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
lines: For in death there is no memory of you.
In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

verses.text: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
lines: I am weary with my groaning.
Every night I flood my bed.
I drench my couch with my tears.

verses.text: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
lines: My eye wastes away because of grief.
It grows old because of all my adversaries.

verses.text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
lines: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity,
for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.text: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.
lines: Yahweh has heard my supplication.
Yahweh accepts my prayer.

verses.text: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
lines: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed.
They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
